completedPages.notes: Full product/UX rebuild. User review on 2026-08-18 rejected the previous dark, heavy system-lab direction as too dry and too similar to other calculators. Visual direction was deliberately pivoted rather than recolored: the hero is now a light physical material-desk/cutaway scene, the result is an order-ticket/receipt, calculator modes use product-specific pastel accents, and dark generic dashboard surfaces were removed from the material atlas and decision area. A prominent methodology-verification block was added directly after the calculator with four primary Rigips CZ links and verified date 2026-08-18. Board presets now include practical 1250×2600, 1200×2600, 1250×3000 plus RBI/RF variants; default examples align to 1250×2600. Result UX now separates purchase quantity, layout/cut check, system sanity check, method boundary and verified-source trust row. Partition/lining logic warns when a height supplement would be below 400 mm; ceiling output states board orientation/cut-layout boundary. No universal screw/tape/putty coefficients are invented. Fire/acoustic/static details remain explicit system-documentation boundaries. Static accessibility/structure and logic fixtures pass. Browser QA was then completed through Playwright using the installed Chromium with in-memory page injection: desktop/mobile screenshots rendered correctly, no horizontal overflow at 320/360/390/768/1024/1280/1440 px, no page errors, keyboard tab Home/End and mobile menu Escape passed. Manual production/deploy gate remains pending. User visual gate passed on 2026-08-18 after the light material-desk redesign ("pecka, mnohem lepší"); page promoted from RELEASE_CANDIDATE to DONE. Production PageSpeed retest remains a non-blocking post-deploy check.
